It also used workspace/record-seeking and repeated teach-back to make the ED handoff and discharge instructions executable. One high-order point was completed through bounded closure of acute glucose safety, medication uncertainty, and gynecology follow-up; the privacy-barrier high-order point was triggered but not actively addressed.
